title: How Do Plants Grow? From Seed to Tree for Kids with Gizmo
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Gizmo the robot, and welcome to Gizmo Explains!
I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to find out how plants grow.
We'll explore five cool things. Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
When my antenna lights up, it means I have an idea!

lines: Here's a clue: it's tiny, and a plant grows from it! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A seed has a baby plant inside.
With water and warmth, it starts to grow!
Can you curl up small like a seed, and then grow tall?
What does a seed need to grow?
One more time, nice and loud: SEED!
The first little sprout pokes up out of the dirt.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: they grow under the ground! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Roots grow down into the soil.
They drink up water, like straws!
Can you stand strong, like roots holding a plant?
Drink water, and hold the plant in place!
One more time, nice and loud: ROOTS!
Carrots are roots we can eat!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: they're green, and they love sunshine! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
They use sunlight, air, and water to make food for the plant!
Can you open your hands wide, like leaves catching the sun?
What do leaves use to make food?
One more time, nice and loud: LEAVES!
Plants also give us fresh air to breathe.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's colorful, and bees love it! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Flowers make a sweet juice called nectar.
Bees visit, and help the flower make new seeds!
Can you buzz like a busy bee? Bzzzz!
One more time, nice and loud: FLOWER!
Then the seeds can grow into new plants.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's tall, with a trunk and branches! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
A tree starts as a tiny seed.
It grows a little bit every year, for many, many years!
Can you stretch up tall like a big tree?
Where does a tree come from?
One more time, nice and loud: TREE!
Some trees grow fruit, like apples!
Now we know how it works. Great job!

recap: Wow, we learned so much! Let's remember.
A seed needs water and warmth.
And a tiny seed can grow into a tree!
outro: Which one was your favorite? Keep asking, how does that work?
Bye, friends! See you next time on Gizmo Explains!
